shortDescription: Get, update & create Airtable records from Ansible.

options.name: airtable_pat
options.description: Airtable personal access token used to authenticate API requests.

options.name: attachment_content_type
options.description: MIME content type of the attachment being uploaded.

options.name: attachment_field_id
options.description: The field ID of the attachment field targeted by upload_attachment.

options.name: attachment_file
options.description: Base64-encoded content of the file to upload as an attachment.

options.name: attachment_filename
options.description: The filename to assign to the uploaded attachment.

options.name: base_id
options.description: The base_id of the Airtable base, e.g. appxxxxxxxxxxxxxx.

options.name: csv_source_file
options.description: Path to a CSV file to upload when using the sync_csv method.

options.name: fields
options.description: List of field name/value dicts used by the create and update methods.

options.name: filter_by_formula
options.description: An Airtable formula used to filter records returned by the list method.

options.name: max_records
options.description: Maximum number of records to return for the list method.

options.name: method
options.description: The operation to perform against the Airtable API.

options.name: offset
options.description: Pagination offset token returned by a previous list request.

options.name: page_size
options.description: Number of records to fetch per page for the list method.

options.name: record_id
options.description: The ID of the Airtable record to get, update, or attach a file to.

options.name: return_fields_by_field_id
options.description: When set, field names in the response are replaced by their field IDs.

options.name: sync_id
options.description: The sync integration ID used by the sync_csv method.

options.name: table_id
options.description: The table_id of the table in the targeted base, e.g. tblxxxxxxxxxxxxxx.
